definitions.gloss: how, in what way, to what extent
definitions.explanation: Used to ask about methods or degree in formal contexts.
Used with ても/とも to express 'no matter how' or to emphasize degree.

examples.japanese: {如何|いか}に⟦{生|い}きる→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧べき⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{如何|いか}に⟦{解決|かいけつ}する→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧だ。
examples.english: The challenge is how to solve the problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{如何|いか}に⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}している→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: This shows how important this technology is.

examples.japanese: {如何|いか}に⟦{努力|どりょく}して→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧だった。
examples.english: No matter how hard I tried, it was impossible.

examples.japanese: {如何|いか}に⟦{難|むずか}しくて→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{諦|あきら}めない→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how difficult it is, I won't give up.

examples.japanese: {如何|いか}に⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{天才|てんさい}→天才：09934_tensai⟧であって⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{限界|げんかい}→限界：02715_genkai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how much of a genius he is, there are limits to what one person can do.

notes:
{如何|いか}に is a formal adverb with two main uses: asking "how" or "in what way," and expressing "no matter how" with て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧/とも.

WRITING:
Usually written in hiragana as いかに. The kanji {如何|いか}に is seen in formal writing.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- いかに〜⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: how ~ (question/rhetorical)
- いかに〜て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: no matter how ~
- いかに〜であって⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: no matter how ~ (even more formal)
- いかに⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: indeed, really, truly (set expression — different nuance)

REGISTER:
Formal and literary. In everyday speech, ⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or ⟦どれ→どれ：00547_dore⟧ほど are more natural alternatives for "no matter how," and ⟦どうやって→どうやって：27496_douyatte⟧ for "how."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: no matter how (casual/neutral)
- ⟦どれ→どれ：00547_dore⟧ほど: how much, to what extent (slightly formal)
- いかに⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: indeed, truly (separate expression, not interchangeable)
